think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/unlimited). 3) Determine whether such values exist and whether they “break” the natural numeric ordering by switching the knob into a qualitatively different mode. 4) If no such sentinel values exist and the knob always behaves as a regular ordered numeric setting, classify it as not special.
